residual_findings_outside_scope.summary: In Root 45740904149, the newly wired post-switch check:management-crawl (scripts/dev_acceptance_stage.py) mints a viewer token (DEV_BFF_DEV_LOGIN_VIEWER_CLIENT_SECRET, identity=viewer) instead of the read-only operator probe identity used by pantheon-integration-gate.yml (DEV_BFF_DEV_LOGIN_OPERATOR_A_CLIENT_ID). While /management/evolution-journal passed (status=ok, dataPass=true) in both crawls, viewer tokens receive HTTP 403 (Approval read role required) on GET /bff/approvals (/bff/approvals/ap_301, /bff/runtimes), causing accept-management-hosted-production.mjs to mark routes that query approvals/runtimes as api_data_failure under viewer auth even though all 111/111 routes pass (0 failures) under operator read-only auth.
